notes: When the plan lists two steps, Run it now does both — it was doing only the first and dropping the rest without a word. Requests Crisp can't do the way you asked now say so instead of starting a long enhance you didn't want: sharpening without enlarging, cropping an exact number of pixels off one edge, or shrinking a clip. "Double the length" repeats the clip instead of upscaling it, and "take the noise out of the audio" cleans the audio.
